paragraphs: Brett Anthony Foods recalled frozen WOW BAO Cheeseburger Bao Buns due to unreported allergens, distributed in Alabama, Colorado, Connecticut, Georgia, Iowa, Maine, Massachusetts, and Michigan [1]. Fresh & Ready Foods recalled Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches in Oregon and Washington due to possible Listeria monocytogenes contamination [4]. Grand Strand Sandwich Company recalled four Lunch Box breakfast sandwich products—Bacon Egg and Cheese Biscuit, Sausage Egg and Cheese Biscuit, Jumbo Sausage Biscuit, and Chicken Sausage Biscuit—due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination [13]. Country Creek LLC recalled Country Creek Acres Alfalfa Sprout Seeds sold nationwide via e-commerce because they may be contaminated with E. coli and Salmonella [2]. D & M Smoked Fish recalled Cold Smoked Sprats distributed in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania due to potential Clostridium botulinum contamination [3].

Francisco Family Foods recalled hydroponically grown Alfalfa Sprouts packaged in 4-ounce and 1-pound bags sold in Montana due to potential E. coli and Salmonella contamination [5]. Prime Food Processing LLC issued a voluntary recall of Dried Herring Fish because the product was not adequately eviscerated [10]. Shanghai San Niu Food Co. recalled Sanniu Evergreen Biscuits and Salt and Pepper Soda Biscuits for undeclared milk and shrimp [12]. Several Class II recalls included Ground Up Nut Butter Cups for plastic fiber contamination, NAGAI SOYEAT GREEN soy paper wrap for undeclared Yellow #5, Brad's Crunchy Kale for elevated thallium levels in Illinois and Rhode Island, and Mana Bakery Peperecha for undeclared FD&C Yellow 5 in New Jersey, New York, and Connecticut [6][7][8][9].
